_finding: Only the online step proves an agent test receipt is ours: every hash in a receipt can be recomputed by its author. A checker that follows redirects, trusts a foreign origin or accepts a differing record would vouch for a forgery (docs/agent-test-tz.md v3 §6).

mutations.name: a differing record is accepted
mutations.expect: FAIL a forgery with every hash recomputed fails online

mutations.name: a foreign origin is fetched
mutations.find: if (!isOurs(r.origin, origins)) { say(false, 'origin', 'the receipt names an origin that is not Proof of Stock'); return { code: EXIT.failed, lines } }
mutations.expect: FAIL a receipt naming a foreign origin is refused before any fetch

mutations.name: redirects are followed
mutations.expect: FAIL a receipt we issued passes online
